headline: Iran to ration electricity from Sunday due to energy shortage worsened by war
summary: Iranian authorities plan power cuts of up to two hours daily from Sunday. President Masud Pezeshkian warned of supply difficulties during winter.
why: Electricity shortages disrupt industrial output and energy supply in Iran, which is a major oil and gas producer under international sanctions.
original_headline: Irán racionará electricidad desde el domingo por escasez energética agravada por la guerra
